The real replay into `events.replay.v3` completed, producing 18,442,107 events and recording 3,118 rejects. The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 was still in progress at 61%; ClickHouse showed 14.9M rows in the incident window versus about 20.5M expected. Keep the incident open until counts match. PR #233 is merged. (source: ses-rp-2, r2-04, r2-06, r2-07, kestrel-analytics/ingest#233)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12; compare ClickHouse counts once it completes. (source: ses-rp-2)

- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled under the 2 Gi memory limit; 5k batches worked. (source: r1-03, r1-05)
- [décision] Do not merge or otherwise touch fork PR #241; Daniel owns the CI check. (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
